name: agent-skills-for-finnish-law
description: Avoimen lähdekoodin skillit ja plugarit, jotka auttavat juristeja ja muita oikeudellisten asioiden parissa työskenteleviä Suomessa hyödyntämään Claudea – suomalaisen oikeuden, lakikielen ja oikeuslähteiden (Finlex, oik.ai, KKO/KHO, HE) ehdoilla. Suomalainen vastine Anthropicin claude-for-legal-kokoelmalle.

plugins.name: legal-core
plugins.description: The cross-cutting foundation for Finnish legal work: legal language and section references, Finnish spelling, legal research into the law in force and into case law (Finlex/oik.ai MCP), and the multi-stage review of a legal document. The base that the other practice-area domains rely on.

plugins.name: legislative-drafting
plugins.description: An aid for drafting statutes: the Legislative Drafter’s Guide (the structure of statutes, language, cross-referencing, the enacting formula), the instructions for drafting government bills (HELO), the guide to the legislative process, and the symbols and inflected forms of statutory language. Based on the official guides.

plugins.name: legislative-consultation
plugins.description: Drafting a statement on legislative reforms and draft acts: analysis of the proposal, impact assessment from the point of view of the body giving the statement, summarising other statements, and writing a reasoned statement. Suitable for municipalities, joint municipal authorities, agencies, organisations and companies.

plugins.name: contracts
plugins.description: Drafting and reviewing contracts under Finnish law: the structure of a contract and an annotated clause library, the fundamentals of contract law, and a clause-by-clause risk assessment (GREEN/YELLOW/RED) with flags for adjustment and for mandatory law.

plugins.name: data-protection
plugins.description: Data protection in the processing of personal data under the EU General Data Protection Regulation (2016/679) and the Data Protection Act (1050/2018): assessing the processing and the need for a DPIA, the privacy notice and the record of processing activities, and responding to requests from data subjects.

plugins.name: ai-regulation
plugins.description: Compliance with the EU AI Act (Regulation (EU) 2024/1689): risk classification of an AI system, the obligations by role and risk tier, and the deadlines, the penalties, the GPAI threshold and the fundamental rights impact assessment (FRIA). Built on the open deterministic EU AI Act MCP.

plugins.name: employment-law
plugins.description: Finnish employment law: drafting and reviewing an employment contract (työsopimuslaki 55/2001), assessing the grounds and the procedure for terminating employment, and co-operation and change negotiations (yhteistoimintalaki 1333/2021). On the terms of mandatory legislation and collective agreements.

plugins.name: administrative-law
plugins.description: Finnish administrative law and public administration: drafting and reviewing an administrative decision (hallintolaki 434/2003), appeals – request for rectification and appeal (laki oikeudenkäynnistä hallintoasioissa 808/2019) – and public access to documents and information requests (julkisuuslaki 621/1999).

plugins.name: dispute-resolution
plugins.description: Resolving a civil dispute in the general courts (oikeudenkäymiskaari 4/1734): drafting the application for a summons, planning and assessing the evidence, and appealing against a judgment (the court of appeal and leave for continued consideration, the Supreme Court and leave to appeal).

plugins.name: company-law
plugins.description: Finnish company law (osakeyhtiölaki 624/2006): incorporation and governance, the general meeting and board work, the liability of management, the two-part test for distributing assets, drafting and risk-checking shareholders’ agreements, and corporate transactions with their due diligence lists.

plugins.name: insolvency
plugins.description: Finnish insolvency law: assessing a situation of insolvency and choosing the procedure (bankruptcy 120/2004, restructuring of enterprises 47/1993, adjustment of debts 57/1993), bankruptcy proceedings from the creditor’s and the debtor’s point of view, and debt collection, limitation and enforcement.

plugins.name: intellectual-property
plugins.description: Finnish intellectual property law: protection strategy and likelihood-of-confusion assessment for trade marks and trade names (544/2019 and 128/1979), copyright with the DSM reforms and licensing (404/1961), and the trade-secret protection programme and infringement situations (595/2018). Links to the Market Court, PRH and EUIPO.

plugins.name: taxation
plugins.description: Finnish taxation for professionals: tax procedure and appeals from a request for rectification to KHO (VML 1558/1995), corporate taxation with group contributions and corporate restructurings (EVL 360/1968), and value added tax (AVL 1501/1993). Tax rates and euro amounts always from the source; an advance ruling where the matter is open to interpretation.

plugins.name: public-procurement
plugins.description: Public procurement under the Public Procurement Act (1397/2016) from the point of view of both the contracting authority and the tenderer: planning and the choice of procedure with the thresholds, the invitation to tender and a compliant tender, and the award decision, procurement rectification and appeal to the Market Court with its sanctions.

plugins.name: criminal-procedure
plugins.description: Finnish criminal procedure for the work of counsel: pre-trial investigation and coercive measures (805/2011 and 806/2011) with preparation for questioning and the closing statement, the charge and the response with the judgment-proposal procedure (ROL 689/1997), and the injured party’s claims and criminal-injuries compensation. On the terms of the presumption of innocence and the use of counsel.

plugins.name: environment-and-planning
plugins.description: Finnish environmental and planning law under the reformed legislation: environmental permits and supervision (YSL 527/2014), land use planning and building (the Land Use Act and the Building Act 751/2023 with their new permits), and environmental liabilities and environmental due diligence in transactions. Takes account of the 2026 authority reform (the Finnish Licensing and Supervision Agency).

plugins.name: real-estate-and-housing
plugins.description: Finnish real estate and housing law: the prescribed form of a conveyance of real property, the registrations and liability for defects (maakaari 540/1995), the sale of a dwelling with the RS system and notices of defect (843/1994), the maintenance liability and governance of a housing company (1599/2009), and leases of residential and business premises with their differences in mandatory force.

plugins.name: competition-law
plugins.description: Finnish and EU competition law: prohibited restrictions of competition and abuse of a dominant position with a self-assessment framework (kilpailulaki 948/2011, Articles 101 and 102 TFEU), merger control with the prohibition on implementation, and compliance programmes, the rules for exchanging information and readiness for a dawn raid.

plugins.name: banking-and-finance
plugins.description: Finnish banking and finance law: finance agreements with their covenants and collateral packages with their perfection (velkakirjalaki 622/1947, takauslaki 361/1999), anti-money-laundering compliance (444/2017), and the disclosure obligation and insider administration of a listed company (AML 746/2012, MAR).

plugins.name: immigration-law
plugins.description: Finnish immigration law from the point of view of the employer and of counsel: work-based residence permits with the labour market test (ulkomaalaislaki 301/2004), the employer’s verification duties and the sanctions, posted workers (447/2016), and EU residence, family reunification, a permanent permit and citizenship (359/2003).

plugins.name: family-and-inheritance
plugins.description: Finnish family and inheritance law for everyday situations: the property relations of marriage and the division of matrimonial property (avioliittolaki 234/1929), the position of a cohabiting partner (26/2011), the custody of a child, contact and maintenance (361/1983 and 704/1975), succession, wills and the compulsory share (perintökaari 40/1965), and guardianship and continuing powers of attorney (442/1999 and 648/2007). The best interests and the safety of the child come first; taxes from the source.

plugins.name: consumer-law
plugins.description: Finnish consumer law in sales between a trader and a consumer (kuluttajansuojalaki 38/1978): liability for defects in goods and services and the remedies, the right of withdrawal and the information duties in distance and off-premises selling, unfair marketing, and the resolution of consumer disputes (the Consumer Disputes Board 8/2007 and KKV 661/2012) and good collection practice for a consumer debt (513/1999). Mandatory in the consumer’s favour.

plugins.name: criminal-law
plugins.description: Finnish substantive criminal law (rikoslaki 39/1889): the general conditions of criminal liability (the principle of legality, intent and negligence, grounds excluding liability, complicity, attempt), the elements and forms of the principal offences, and the determination of the sentence, forfeiture and limitation. Complements the criminal-procedure domain. It serves the defence, the injured party and compliance; it does not assist in committing or concealing an offence.

plugins.name: bilingual-legal-language
plugins.description: Support for Finnish–Swedish bilingualism in legal work: translating legal language and the established terminology FI↔SV from official sources (the parallel texts in Finlex, the Government Term Bank), and linguistic rights and the language obligations of an authority (kielilaki 423/2003, perustuslaki 731/1999 section 17, the Act on the Knowledge of Languages Required of Personnel in Public Bodies 424/2003 and the Sámi Language Act 1086/2003). A term is never invented; an official translation comes from an authorised translator.
